label: CRAM (PL with SGD, free 3x3 kernel, focused Gibbs T=0)
test_set: EqR maze-30x30-unique-1k test (1,000 mazes), x 3 training seeds
provenance: (SGD lr 1, 20 updates; consistency screen on dev100): runs/CU13/final/fg-s*; maze_unique.py, cram/cram_maze.py
notes: focused Gibbs at T 0 from every open cell on, as cram-fg; the energy is CRAMMazeFreeEnergy, trained with SGD. Model: cram.cram_maze.CRAMMazeFreeEnergy, 18 stored = 18 learned parameters (as cram-free-fg). Recipe: pseudo-likelihood only, free kernel, zero start, window 1, 20 SGD updates (momentum 0.5, cosine decay, no clip), batch 64, lr 1.0, l1 0.0, no post-fit compression or rescaling, T as stated; trained on all 1,000 training mazes. GPU: the synchronized update loop on one H200, warm, median of 5 per seed, mean over seeds. CPU: the whole loop on one CPU thread (median of 3).

fit_timing.definition: Fit time: synchronized wall clock from the training data in host memory (as the row's loader reads them from disk) to the inference-ready model and its inference statistics; includes format conversion, device transfer, initialization, augmentation, every forward, backward and optimizer step, compilation and CUDA-graph capture with their warm-up steps, post-fit compression, stopping thresholds and focus statistics fitted from training solutions, support estimation and latent caching; excludes reading files, evaluation and saving. Cold: the first fit in a fresh process (CUDA context creation reported separately); warm: median of 7 further full fits in the same process. GPU: one H200. CPU: one thread (torch.set_num_threads(1)) in a CPU-only job.
timed_ops: maze_unique.load on the raw .npy arrays (int64 casts, tokens, path targets, free mask)
transfer of the 1,000 training mazes (tokens, targets, free mask) to the device
torch.manual_seed; CRAMMazeEnergy (its random init) or CRAMMazeFreeEnergy (zero start) construction and transfer; Adam construction
batch-index draws (numpy, seeded) for every update and their transfer
every update: pseudo-likelihood loss, backward, gradient-norm clip, Adam step
maze_unique.train bookkeeping: per-update losses copied to the host, count of entries with a gradient
SGD rows (CU12): the cosine learning rate set per update and, with l1 > 0, the soft-threshold
no post-fit compression and no inference statistics (the stopping test is a fixed point; start and step size are constants)
